processed.text: feels quieter in here. like i just walked into the library

I'm not sure whether it's the blue walls or the nature of the guests, but this is the quieter coffee shop of two nanoblogs

Kinda miss the chaos energy of the bad bird place, but I think it would be unwise to keep all my eggs in that basket

I wish anything happened here. I've been live chatting a friend of mine every new "bisk" on the feed and it's like one transfem posting a meme every hour

I want a nanoblog where people are neither insufferable schoolmarms nor evil retards but alas

The state says I get 4 hours mandatory off time to vote

I hope the line is short so that I can use most of it to play slay the spire

Sure beats watching needles on newspaper websites
this objection considered inconvenient unless tweeted from within a 7/11 or similar

not sure i miss the thinly disguised racism but at least it was a good target for my contrarianism

now i have to be contrary about overly sensitive zoomers or academics speaking in therapy talk

fair enough i guess but it lacks a certain je ne sais qua... they're honestly more lame than evil...

maybe if the lady wins the thingy that shall not be named today, the other website will break and more people will come here

inshalla there will be others
